entry.cost_basis: Exact listed rate of the base model google/gemma-4-E4B-it (DeepInfra, frozen 25 Sep 2026 catalog snapshot, USD 0.02/M input, 0.10/M output); this line is added to the frozen pricing module at its next re-freeze. No output tokens under the author's --no-think mode. COMMON COST BASIS: the published cost uses the same remaining 1,485 items as every other row: 701,161 input tokens, USD 0.009443245791245792 per 1,000 decisions (0.146x cap). ALL-ITEMS DIAGNOSTIC: USD 0.010571213333333333 per 1,000 over all 1,500 items (0.164x cap). All items still count for Intelligence.
entry.disclosure: Chon family, same author as the 12B sibling. --no-think is the author's documented CPU mode, a different serving configuration from the GPU default: the think pass that fires on up to 45 % of questions never runs. GPU re-time in the same --no-think serving configuration as the previous CPU measurement; the default think pass is not exercised. The yes/no commit rule [0.199, 0.801] moves P(yes) just outside the scorer's decisive band: the author's own mechanism. Fifteen states over 6,000 tokens are truncated keeping the start, answered rather than refused. The 231-public-item check was a sanity gate, not an independence check: the author used public items to choose serving settings. ATTEMPT HISTORY: an earlier think-on GPU attempt stopped at the public projection gate before any sealed byte and contributes no scored output. This no-think GPU run is the sole successful replacement measurement. All 1,500 items answered, zero output tokens and zero thinking items. GPU telemetry sampler produced an empty CSV; utilisation and clock samples are unavailable.
entry.endpoint_condition: Evaluator-owned rented Verda RTX A6000 48 GB, FIN-01 (Finland, EU), non-preemptible, measured 25 Oct 2026. Disposable read-only container with no network; network cut proven inside the container before sealed input. Author's chon.serve 1.0.0 at revision 35fb1142d9f4e68850bcb12d2df8b0b3564e0fc0, --device cuda --dtype bfloat16 --no-think; PyTorch 2.9.1+cu128, transformers 5.19.0, peft 0.18.1. GPU sampler CSV was empty; host CPU model was not retained in the collected receipts. Published Speed applies the standard self-hosted x2 + 0.15 s adjustment (assumption, not measured). Rental about USD 0.14 is separate from the unchanged listed inference tariff.
